purpose: Catch the actual visible narrow-byte renderer by breaking on the UV floats of glyph U+00EC (index 135), which the Stage39H GPU dump proved is the first visible sprite of the corrupted menu label.

stage39j_conclusion.story_sequence: The wide Unicode path sees U+C2A4, U+D1A0, U+B9AC correctly.
stage39j_conclusion.why_that_does_not_explain_visible_output: Stage39H GPU vertices contain no Korean atlas coordinates for the visible top item. They contain nine original-Latin/fallback sprites instead.

stage39h_gpu_proof.interpretation: The visible menu draw is a separate narrow-byte path. EC 8A A4 ED ... is mapped byte-by-byte to the original font.
